title: stats2data_application
text: stats2data simulates raw datasets whose summary statistics match reported summary statistics (targets). module defines objective, discrepancy summary statistics candidate dataset targets, minimizes simulated annealing. run stops best objective value falls convergence threshold thresh iteration budget spent. vignette, run whose best objective value thresh called converged. Convergence statement optimization : simulated summary statistics reproduce targets within thresh. Many different datasets share summary statistics, simulated dataset one . results therefore described terms optimization (objective values, target-vs-simulated differences, run--run variability), terms closely simulated data resemble unobserved original data. vignette works four examples: Descriptives module (optim_vec()), using reported marginal statistics Bardwell et al. (2007); MLR module (optim_mlr()), using reported correlations regression estimates study; ANOVA module (optim_aov()), using reported cell means F-statistics Reynolds Besner (2008), accompanying manuscript; parallel workflow (parallel_optim()), using ANOVA example. Across examples, following functions demonstrated: optimization functions optim_vec(), optim_mlr(), optim_aov(), parallel_optim(); GRIM check check_grim(); inspection methods print(), summary(), get_stats(), get_rmse(), coef(); plotting functions plot_convergence(), plot_cooling(), plot_fit(), plot_stability(), plot() methods; Shiny interface run_app().

title: stats2data_application
text: study reports 2 x 2 within-subjects design (S = 16) four cell means, indexed stimulus type (Factor1) switch condition (Factor2): 543, 536, 614, 618 ms. reports MSE = 3070 Factor1 effect, F(1, 15) = 30.5 (partial eta squared .670) Factor1, F < 1 Factor2 (.002) interaction (.015). code section code empirical example manuscript, reproduces results reported . numerator mean squares implied cell means balanced 2 x 2 within-subjects design : reported Factor1 statistics consistent : implied mean square divided reported MSE gives F = 30.5, F / (F + df_error) gives reported partial eta squared .670. two effects reported F < 1, F-statistics set reported partial eta squared via F = eta^2 * df_error / (1 - eta^2) (one numerator degree freedom). modules require bounds outcome, study report; range reported cell means extended four times sqrt(MSE), residual SD implied MSE, rounded outward. summary statistics encoded one list optim_aov() arguments: target_group_means lists cells Factor1 varying slowest (11, 12, 21, 22).
code: S   <- 16 mse <- 3070 target_group_means <- c(543, 536, 614, 618) eta2   <- c(0.002, 0.015)  # Factor2, Factor1:Factor2 df_err <- S - 1 m_cell  <- matrix(target_group_means, nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)  # rows: Factor1, cols: Factor2 m_grand <- mean(m_cell) ms_f1   <- S * 2 * sum((rowMeans(m_cell) - m_grand)^2) ms_f2   <- S * 2 * sum((colMeans(m_cell) - m_grand)^2) ms_int  <- S * sum((m_cell - outer(rowMeans(m_cell), colMeans(m_cell), "+") + m_grand)^2) c(ms_f1 = ms_f1, ms_f2 = ms_f2, ms_int = ms_int) #>  ms_f1  ms_f2 ms_int  #>  93636     36    484 stopifnot(round(ms_f1 / mse, 1) == 30.5) stopifnot(round(30.5 / (30.5 + df_err), 3) == 0.670) F_value_derived <- c(round(ms_f1 / mse, 1), round(eta2 * df_err / (1 - eta2), 3))  sumstats <- list(   S                  = S,   levels             = c(2, 2),   factor_type        = c("within", "within"),   formula            = "outcome ~ Factor1 * Factor2 + Error(ID / (Factor1 * Factor2))",   integer            = FALSE,   target_f_list      = list(     effect  = c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Factor1:Factor2"),     F_value = F_value_derived   ),   target_group_means = target_group_means,   range              = c(floor(min(target_group_means) - 4 * sqrt(mse)),                          ceiling(max(target_group_means) + 4 * sqrt(mse))) ) sumstats$target_f_list$F_value #> [1] 30.500  0.030  0.228 sumstats$range #> [1] 314 840
